messages:
evan.reid: Quick sync on AUTHZ postmortem follow-ups. I want a single place to track owners, dates, and recurring patterns so we can close the loop.

Tanya.singh: Thanks Evan. I'm happy to coordinate. Proposed list: (1) token validation robustness -> owner @kevin.lo, due 2026-05-03; (2) audit-event coverage/backfill -> owner @tanya.singh, due 2026-05-08; (3) secrets-rotation drift detection -> owner @evan.reid, due 2026-05-15.

kevin.lo: I'll take (1). Plan: normalize token whitespace/padding, move expiry checks into auth-core, add fuzz tests and a small canary. Will open PR and target staging by 2026-04-28. Feature flag: auth.strict_parse_v3.

audit-agent: Note: created task TASK-5010 (owner: tanya.singh, due: 2026-05-08).

tanya.singh: For (2) I'll run a 90-day replay of auth logs and identify gaps. Deliverables: replay report, CI test that ensures critical paths emit audit.events, and a backfill plan for missing events.

evan.reid: For secrets rotation drift: add metric `secret_rotator_last_ok{env}` + alert if >48h, and daily digest to #security. I'll also update the rotator runbook with remediation steps.

kevin.lo: Blocker: need a representative legacy token for unit tests. @tanya.singh can you put masked examples in the secure artifacts path?

tanya.singh: Done. Uploaded masked vectors to secure store and linked in TASK-5010.

kevin.lo: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 48h; if canary 4xx spikes beyond baseline +0.3%, disable flag. Will include X-Authz-Canary header for correlation.

evan.reid: Good. Also add a short telemetry check to detect silent-accepts: compare token decode hashes vs observed principal for 1% sample.

sec-bot: Recurring reminder set -> weekly triage Fridays 09:15 (thread: 1815000000).

tanya.singh: I'll create the replay issue and add the `postmortem-remediation: AUTHZ-2026` tag to all related PRs. Also creating label `authz-followup`.

kevin.lo: PR #910 opened for token canonicalization. Adding unit tests and feature-flag gating.

evan.reid: Great. I'll publish a short rollup after the first weekly sync summarizing progress and any recurring patterns we see across incidents.

audit-agent: Reminder: Dashboard tile created -> audit-coverage-30d.

tanya.singh: First check-in scheduled: 2026-04-29 11:00 to review replay output + canary results.

evan.reid: Thanks team. If anyone needs to reassign, ping here and set the task owner accordingly. :thumbsup:
